description: Implementation of a client class for uploading telemetry data to a Hono server using Vertx-Proton, including methods for creating sender instances, sending messages with tracing, and handling delivery outcomes.

classes.name: TelemetrySenderImpl
classes.description: A client class for sending telemetry data to a Hono server using AMQP protocol with tracing and delivery handling.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the AMQP target address for telemetry data, based on tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns the target address for a specific device ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new telemetry sender instance for a given connection and tenant.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the delivery outcome, with optional tracing context.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends an AMQP message, manages timeout, and updates tracing based on delivery status.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Starts a new tracing span for forwarding telemetry data.

methods.name: startChildSpan
methods.description: Creates a child tracing span for telemetry data forwarding.
